instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for BeneficiaryWillow Designation Review: The objective is to review beneficiary-designation change requests and update policy records after request completeness and beneficiary eligibility are confirmed. Policyholders submit requests with policy and designation information. Service Clerks check signatures and record supporting evidence. Eligibility Reviewers record eligibility and reasons for ineligibility. Policy Records Officers record new beneficiary designations after completeness and eligibility are confirmed. Customer Correspondence Clerks send outcomes to Policyholders. Claim payment and policy cancellation are outside the project. The accepted evidence types, eligibility criteria, and outcome delivery channel are undecided.
